ideas.text: An AI HOA assistant that detects grass disrespect from satellite imagery.
A city-planning copilot that rezones neighborhoods based on vibes and cold-brew density.
A smart parking app that auctions curb space to whoever can sound most urgent.
A neighborhood watch bot that flags suspicious behavior like reading on a porch.
An AI political consultant for local candidates who want to pivot from potholes to personal brand.
A school-pickup optimizer that routes SUVs like fighter jets.
A municipal chatbot that answers every complaint with a five-question survey about innovation.
An AI tax prep tool that itemizes your emotional support candles as home office infrastructure.
A landlord copilot that writes rent increase emails in the tone of mindful leadership.
A civic engagement app that turns zoning hearings into bracket-style tournaments.
An AI church bulletin generator that slips in sponsored content for artisanal funeral homes.
A public transit predictor that explains delays with astrological certainty and zero operational data.
A smart trash can that reports your recycling habits to a neighborhood leaderboard.
An AI jury duty assistant that practices looking attentive while learning nothing.
A town hall summarizer that converts resident outrage into pastel infographics.
A pothole-detection startup that refuses to repair anything without a premium subscription.
A borderless community app that geofences empathy by property value.
An AI emergency alert system that sends push notifications like movie trailers.
A permit application helper that creates attachments until your Wi-Fi gives up.
A local news aggregator that rewrites every story as evidence of societal collapse.
